rationale: Describes agentless discovery of enterprise applications, configurations, and dependencies plus release automation and orchestration integrated with CI/CD, conventional IT inventory and deployment workflows.
evidence_spans:
Matilda discovery automatically discovers all enterprise applications, the configurations and dependencies on an agentless basis. 

Our software solution supports DevOps initiatives using release automation and orchestration features that allow integration with existing CI/CD tools and accelerate the movement from dev to test, to staging, and then production.
